units: <cite ref="Exodus 25">B’shall. 25</cite> (play on <he>ר̇פ̇י̇ד̇י̇ם̇</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 17:8">Ex. XVII, 8</cite>) <he>שאין השונא בא אלא על ר̇פ̇יון י̇ד̇י̇ם̇ מן התורה</he> the enemy comes (against Israel) only for laxity of hands in upholding the Law.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:1">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>מר׳ התורה וכ׳</he> for neglect of the Law are your children seized.

<cite ref="Arakhin 5b:54">Arakh. 5ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezra 4:3">Ezra IV, 3</cite>) <he>משום ר׳ ידים הוא</he> the exclusion of the gentiles from participation in the building of the Temple had its reason in the weakening of the hands (the intention to discourage the Jews, ib. 4).

senses.gloss: [swinging,] suspense of judgment; תלה בר׳ to leave in suspense.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:12">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>תלאו בר׳ וכ׳</he> he kept his (Cain’s) judgment in suspense, until the flood came and carried him off; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:12">ib.</cite> s. 32 <he>היה תלוי בר׳</he>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31">Ex. R. s. 31</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:3:1">Koh. R. to VI, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:4">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>אני תולה אותך בר׳ וכ׳</he> I leave thy judgment in suspense, until Moses shall come &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 12">Ex. R. s. 12</cite>, end <he>תלאן בר׳ ואימתי וכ׳</he> he held them (the thunders) in suspense, and when did they come down? In the days of Joshua &c.; a. e.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:1:7">Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>תליין יהושע בדופן</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:7:3">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בריפן</he>, prob. to be read: <he>ברפיון</he>.]
